targetTexts.1: A prayer of one who is afflicted, when he grows faint and pours out his lament before the LORD. Hear my prayer, O LORD; let my cry for help come before You.
targetTexts.2: Do not hide Your face from me in my day of distress. Incline Your ear to me; answer me quickly when I call.
targetTexts.3: For my days vanish like smoke, and my bones burn like glowing embers.
targetTexts.4: My heart is afflicted, and withered like grass; I even forget to eat my bread.
targetTexts.5: Through my loud groaning my skin hangs on my bones.
targetTexts.6: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.
targetTexts.7: I lie awake; I am like a lone bird on a housetop.
targetTexts.8: All day long my enemies taunt me; they ridicule me and curse me.
targetTexts.9: For I have eaten ashes like bread and mixed my drink with tears
targetTexts.10: because of Your indignation and wrath, for You have picked me up and cast me aside.
targetTexts.11: My days are like lengthening shadows, and I wither away like grass.
targetTexts.12: But You, O LORD, sit enthroned forever; Your renown endures to all generations.
targetTexts.13: You will rise up and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show her favor—the appointed time has come.
targetTexts.14: For Your servants delight in her stones and take pity on her dust.
targetTexts.15: So the nations will fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth will fear Your glory.
targetTexts.16: For the LORD will rebuild Zion; He has appeared in His glory.
targetTexts.17: He will turn toward the prayer of the destitute; He will not despise their prayer.
targetTexts.18: Let this be written for the generation to come, so that a people not yet created may praise the LORD.
targetTexts.19: For He looked down from the heights of His sanctuary; the LORD gazed out from heaven to earth
targetTexts.20: to hear a prisoner’s groaning, to release those condemned to death,
targetTexts.21: that they may proclaim the name of the LORD in Zion and praise Him in Jerusalem,
targetTexts.22: when peoples and kingdoms assemble to serve the LORD.
targetTexts.23: He has broken my strength on the way; He has cut short my days.
targetTexts.24: I say: “O my God, do not take me in the midst of my days! Your years go on through all generations.
targetTexts.25: In the beginning You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
targetTexts.26: They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing You will change them, and they will be passed on.
targetTexts.27: But You remain the same, and Your years will never end.
targetTexts.28: The children of Your servants will dwell securely, and their descendants will be established before You.”
